## What this changes and why

## Checks

- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm test` pass.
- [ ] If this changes what can be sent, to whom or how often, a test shows the guard still holds.
- [ ] Text from the web or from a reply is wrapped with `untrusted()` before it reaches a model.
- [ ] The README still says what the code does.
